g.title: LEG2
g.text: The one equation this map is built around
G_tonic(t) = G₀ × Rδ(t) × [1 + E₀ · PAM(t)^h/(EC₅₀^h + PAM(t)^h)]
PAM(t) falls with τ ≈ 12 h after placental expulsion
Rδ(t) re-expands with τ ≈ 7 d (168 h)
A product of a fast fall and a slow rise
The trough — not the level — is the disease window.
a BRIDGE, which is why 60 h of drug buys 30 days of benefit.
